name: Storebird AI Chat for WooCommerce
author: velocityplugins

sections.description:
Storebird is an AI-powered customer support chatbot designed specifically for WooCommerce stores. It helps your customers get instant answers about:

  • Product information and recommendations
  • Order status and tracking
  • Shipping and delivery questions
  • Returns and refunds
  • General store inquiries

Features

  • AI-Powered Responses: Uses advanced AI to understand and respond to customer questions
  • Product Search: Automatically searches your product catalog to provide relevant recommendations
  • Order Tracking: Customers can check their order status directly in the chat
  • Lead Capture: Collect customer information for follow-up
  • Human Handoff: Seamlessly transfer conversations to human agents when needed
  • Customizable Branding: Match the chat widget to your store’s look and feel
  • Real-time Sync: Automatically syncs your products and orders
  • One-Click Connect: Connect your plugin to Storebird with a single click

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher (optional, for product sync and order tracking)
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A Storebird account (https://storebird.ai)

External Services

This plugin connects to the Storebird API service to provide AI-powered chat functionality.

Storebird API

This plugin sends data to and receives data from the Storebird API (https://storebird.ai/api) for the following purposes:

Data sent:
* Product information (names, prices, descriptions, images) – when syncing products
* Chat messages from customers – when customers use the chat widget
* Visitor information (page URL, session ID) – for chat context
* WordPress and WooCommerce version info – during connection setup

When data is sent:
* On initial plugin connection (automatic or manual)
* On product sync (manual trigger in admin)
* When products are created/updated in WooCommerce
* When customers send messages through the chat widget

Service links:
* Service website: https://storebird.ai
* Terms of Service: https://storebird.ai/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://storebird.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from WordPress.org or upload to /wp-content/plugins/storebird-plugin/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Click the connect link from your Storebird dashboard — the plugin connects automatically!
  4. Sync your products to enable AI product recommendations
sections.faq:
Do I need a Storebird account?

Yes, you need to create an account at https://storebird.ai to get started.

Is this plugin free?

The plugin is free, but you need a Storebird subscription to use the AI chat features.

How do I connect the plugin?

After creating your website on the Storebird dashboard, click the connect link provided — the plugin will connect automatically. You can also enter API credentials manually if you prefer.

How do I customize the chat widget?

You can customize colors, logos, and messages from your Storebird dashboard at https://storebird.ai/dashboard.
